services.description: SSSD responders to start (nss, pam, sudo, autofs, ssh, pac).

domains.description: Identity domains: name, id_provider (ldap, ad, ipa, proxy, files), optional auth_provider, and further sssd.conf(5) options as key/value pairs (ldap_uri, ldap_search_base, ad_domain, proxy_lib_name, …). A site value: sssd refuses to start without one ("No domains configured, fatal error!").
